verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents JSON transcript output from the API (whisper-docs-4) and CLI or Python transcription from the open-source repo. No item mentions SRT or VTT output formats, a caption export option, or a documented path to produce subtitle files. A community mention of live captioning via whisper.cpp is a user-modified port, not a documented SRT/VTT export, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export a transcript as SRT or VTT captions through the API or a documented path
